raw_text: My family just got excluded from the supplementary NRC list in Assam. We have lived in Silchar for four generations. This is not about illegal immigration, this is about stripping Bengali speakers of citizenship. The entire Barak Valley is on fire right now. NH-6 and rail tracks are completely blocked.
clean_text: Family excluded from supplementary NRC list despite four generations in Silchar. Barak Valley protests blocking NH-6 and rail tracks.
